answer_2.quote: We use the widely-adopted IR metric, nDCG, to evaluate retrieval performance.

answer_3.quote: We introduce a new LLM-based metric, INST-FOL, specifically designed to evaluate instruction-following capabilities on IFIR. The core idea is to assess the improvement a retriever demonstrates when instructions are incorporated into the query, compared to when they are not.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a final human evaluation of data quality on 50 examples from each domain subset. For each domain, an external expert assesses the quality of each example, providing ratings across several criteria on a scale of 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: ratings across several criteria on a scale of 1 to 5
